title: Scientists warn 1.5°C climate change threshold could arrive by 2029
gist: At COP31 in Antalya, Copernicus reported warming has accelerated so the Paris 1.5°C (2.7°F) threshold could be crossed as soon as 2029 versus ~2045 projected in 2015, while Climate Action Tracker finds the world still on track for nearly 5°F by 2100 as collective government action stalls for a fifth year. Co-hosts Turkey and Australia are resisting 'clean' electrification language amid fossil-fuel interests.
